name: Max Rep Deadlift

origin.summary: An event from the 2010 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A one-minute max-rep deadlift test at a fixed weight, immediately preceding a separately scored max-load shoulder-to-overhead on the same clock.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2010/2 (official CrossFit Games event, individual division), retrieved 2026-07-10; available sources report a single 264 lb load without a gender split -- flagged per CONTRIBUTING rather than assumed
